definitions.xi: ln(p/p_dew)/ln(p_bubble/p_dew) with Wilson saturation pressures of the row's own mixture and temperature; 0 = dew point (F_V = 1), 1 = bubble point (F_V = 0)
definitions.bands: the 5% of test rows with the smallest xi (dew band) and the 5% with the largest (bubble band), the rest the middle; the same xi limits are applied to the extrapolation set
definitions.groups: 20 equal-count groups of each set's rows ranked by xi
definitions.worst_errors: the 1% of rows with the largest absolute error, per model
definitions.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole mixtures with replacement (seed 20261004); paired RMSE difference of fixed trained models; represents dependence on which mixtures are in the evaluation set, not training variability
definitions.seed_spread: population std (ddof=0) over seeds 0, 1, 2: training-run variability
